messages:
Ava: Need a quick battlecard refresh focused on buyer jobs: platform engs, PMs, SREs. Can we get a one-pager + SDR script by tomorrow?

Tom: I'll draft three lead claims per buyer. Platform engs: 'one API, predictable P95, routing by policy.' PMs: 'ship features faster, fewer infra headaches.' SREs: 'deterministic failover + audit trails.'

Rhea: For webinar benchmarks use relative wording only. Show median and p95 latency at 5/30/100 qps, seq len 64/256. Include methodology appendix.

Ben: Objection handlers (30s):
- "We use cloud endpoints": "Good for burst; Redwood gives predictable capacity + SLA-backed Dedicated pools."
- "Lock-in worries": "Routing + model portability minimize app changes."
- "Cost claims": "We show normalized per-1k-token comparisons and test caveats."

Ava: Email subjects to test: A) 'Predictable inference—start shipping features' B) 'Stop guessing model latency'. We'll A/B by demo booking rate.

Tom: SDR routing snippet (ops to implement): score = latency_issue*60 + sla_need*30 + data_class*10. queues: score<50 -> inbound; 50-79 -> sd-ops; >=80 -> enterprise.

Rhea: Demo plan: scripted canary failure -> show auto-route to quantized local -> fallback to hosted. Capture console and include logs in appendix.

Ben: Legal: avoid vendor names and absolute numeric comparisons. Use "up to" and clear test caveats.

marketing-bot: Landing page draft pushed: https://events.redwood.ai/launch-demo (staging) :rocket:

Ava: Owners: Tom copy + battlecard, Rhea slides + demo script, Ben legal-run and rebut bullets. Reconvene 9:30am tomorrow for sign-off.

Tom: Will share battlecard draft by 3pm PT.

Rhea: I'll drop a minimal methodology appendix with raw test configs.

Ben: I'll run legal review first thing tomorrow.

Ava: Thanks team — keep language developer-focused and avoid hard $ claims.
